init.title: Settings
init.description: The daily reminder checks at the set time whether a school day in the period has no order, and only then sends a notification. Days with entries in the holiday calendar are skipped. Optionally it can also remind shortly before each order deadline.

data.dashboard_neu: Recreate this child's view in the dashboard
data.erinnerung_vorlauf: Also remind before the order deadline (hours, 0 = off)
data.app_link: Link for notifications (optional, e.g. an app or shortcut)

data_description.erinnerung_tage: 1 = tomorrow only, 7 = one week, at most 21. Also used for the hint on the card.
data_description.erinnerung_vorlauf: e.g. 3: if an open day's order deadline is less than 3 hours away, a separate notification is sent. Once per day.
data_description.app_link: Replaces the order portal link in notifications. For an app without its own link: create a shortcut that opens the app and enter shortcuts://run-shortcut?name=Name here.

error.ziele_fehlen: Choose at least one recipient for the reminder.

kein_essen.name: No meal needed
kein_essen.description: Marks days on which deliberately no meal is ordered (e.g. home schooling). No reminder or hint for these days.
